completed.title: First production TTS actor integration
details: Mapped the production identity gnisu to one actor
StartTts completed before direct blocking Kokoro playback
StopTts completed after playback and returned the actor to idle

completed.title: Serial multi-actor production TTS isolation
details: Mapped gnisu and dascribe to different actors and exercised both production routes
An unmapped broadcaster identity remained on direct blocking OpenAI playback
The single production queue intentionally serializes voices to keep streams clean and understandable
Overlap is not applicable under the accepted serial-queue design

completed.title: LAN-enabled Windows release package
details: ASAdventurer.exe and ASAdventurerLAN.exe built successfully with pkg 5.8.1 and GZip compression
Both ZIP paths use the Archiver 8 ZipArchive constructor API
The final release/ASAdventurer.zip archive was created at 30.5 MB
Required launchers, checksum files, certificate setup, documentation, and Streamer.bot helper source were present

completed.title: Clean-folder packaged release smoke test
details: The release ZIP was extracted and exercised outside the repository working tree
The LAN server ran on one computer while the browser and OBS ran on another LAN computer
The remote browser loaded the main and actor overlays
The initial transparent OBS result was traced to an untrusted generated LAN root certificate on the OBS computer
Installing the generated root certificate and restarting browser and OBS processes restored trusted HTTPS rendering
The owner confirmed the main and actor overlays were working

validation.details: Main and actor overlays rendered in browser and OBS on same-computer localhost and remote secure-LAN setups.
Both executables, checksum files, final 30.5 MB ZIP, launchers, certificate setup, documentation, and helper source were produced and verified.
The extracted package served remote browser and OBS clients across the LAN. Main and actor OBS overlays rendered after the generated root certificate was trusted on the OBS computer.

known_limits.details: Production TTS intentionally uses one serial queue.
A full LAN process restart cannot restore a held emote that existed before the process stopped.
No quantitative CPU or GPU benchmark has been recorded.
GitHub reports no commit status contexts for PR #8; no CI pass is claimed.
The optional Queri demo model was not bundled because it was absent from public/assets.
Each remote Windows browser or OBS computer must trust the generated LAN root certificate and restart browser processes.
PR #8 remains draft and unmerged. Marking it ready or merging requires explicit owner approval.

security.note: Status and documentation files must contain examples only and must never contain live credentials.
